Overview

MZmine is a modular environment for mass-spectrometry data processing with graphical and batch interfaces. It supports workflows spanning raw-data import, chromatogram construction, feature detection and resolving, alignment, ion and isotope grouping, quality filtering, visualization, spectral-library matching, and export to downstream annotation or networking resources.

Detailed capability map

What can this tool do?

Chromatogram buildingPeak or feature detectionSpectral deconvolutionRetention-time alignmentGap fillingAdduct and isotope groupingBlank and contaminant filteringSpectral-library matchingIon identity networkingNetwork visualizationInteractive dashboard

Common uses

  • Detect, align, and filter features in untargeted LC-MS datasets.
  • Inspect chromatograms, spectra, ion-mobility data, and imaging-MS features.
  • Export feature and spectral data to annotation and molecular-networking resources.

Scope and considerations

Designed for

  • Modular processing and inspection of untargeted LC-MS datasets, including feature-based workflows that retain links to MS/MS and ion-mobility information.
  • Interactive and batch processing where users want a graphical environment with export to downstream annotation and molecular-networking tools.

Not designed for

  • A replacement for every downstream structure-elucidation or statistical-analysis platform; specialist tools are commonly used after preprocessing.

Important requirements

  • Desktop installation; current releases bundle the runtime required to execute MZmine.

Considerations

  • Parameter choices for feature detection, resolving, alignment, and filtering remain experiment dependent and should be documented in reproducible batch files.
